column1: # The 20 `in-text` oligo rows, enumerated 2026-10-27 (ROADMAP: oligo adjudication leftovers).
# sequence OCCURS in the cited paper's text but the extractor found no oligo table listing it --
# usually a primer table rendered as an image, a sequence set in running prose, or a table the
# PDF text layer glues to its neighbours. It is weaker than `exact` (the string could in principle
# sit inside a printed target sequence rather than a primer list) and stronger than `absent`.
# These rows were never enumerated before; the verifier reported the count and nothing else.
# What each needs: a human reading the page the string is on, once, and either promoting the
# entry's confidence (the string is a primer in a table the extractor could not parse) or
# recording where else it appears. Nothing here changes a stored sequence: every one of these
#            then filter verdict == in-text. 505 oligos checked, 421 exact, 20 in-text (2026-10-27).
